sources_reviewed.title: FAO Food Price Index — October 2026
sources_reviewed.finding: 133.9 points, −1.2% m/m, +5.9% y/y; cereals −4.5% m/m; sugar +6.6% m/m. Commodity benchmark only, not household affordability.

sources_reviewed.title: Anvisa PARA 2026 sampling plan
sources_reviewed.finding: 3,613 samples across 14 foods; collection runs through 2 December 2026; no 2026 residue results available at cut-off.

sources_reviewed.title: WOAH HPAI outbreak vigilance
sources_reviewed.finding: Reported outbreaks increased over the previous three weeks in poultry and wild birds; this is an alert for surveillance, not proof of a new global pandemic or human transmission.

sources_reviewed.title: WHO MERS — Qatar
sources_reviewed.finding: Two confirmed cases with camel exposure; 99 contacts tested negative; no secondary cases identified; WHO describes sporadic zoonotic infections, not sustained human transmission.

sources_reviewed.title: WHO Shamonda virus in human — France
sources_reviewed.finding: First documented human infection; source and route remain unknown; no inference of sustained human transmission.

sources_reviewed.title: WHO Bundibugyo virus outbreak update
sources_reviewed.finding: As of 17 November, 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths across 68 health zones in eight DRC provinces; PHEIC continued on 18 November; no new countries reported cases since prior update.

sources_reviewed.title: WHO TrACSS 2026 implementation survey
sources_reviewed.finding: 183 countries; 173 national plans; 22% report funding plus full implementation; 36% report reference-laboratory capacity.

sources_reviewed.title: WOAH ANIMUSE Global Report — 2024 data
sources_reviewed.finding: 119 quantitative participants cover 74% of food-animal biomass; only five use farm records; 2024 animal-use baseline and species-level collection now beginning.

sources_reviewed.title: ECDC/WHO Europe AMR surveillance — 2025 data
sources_reviewed.finding: Invasive human-isolate surveillance; 21/43 countries report ≥50% third-generation cephalosporin resistance in K. pneumoniae; 21/38 report ≥50% carbapenem resistance in Acinetobacter.

sources_reviewed.title: ECDC ESAC-Net antimicrobial consumption — 2025
sources_reviewed.finding: EU/EEA consumption down 5% from 2019, but still above 2030 target; AWaRe Access share 62.5% versus 65% target.

sources_reviewed.title: WHO Global Action Plan on AMR 2026–2036
sources_reviewed.finding: Updated global policy framework; implementation and financing remain the key monitored constraints.

sources_reviewed.title: NBS China October industrial production
sources_reviewed.finding: Industrial production +4.8% y/y; high-tech manufacturing +17.6%; ferrous metals and steel output weaker.

sources_reviewed.title: NBS China October national economy
sources_reviewed.finding: Retail sales +0.4% y/y; fixed investment −8.1% Jan–Oct; real-estate investment −21.6%.

sources_reviewed.title: China Mining Association / GACC iron-ore imports
sources_reviewed.finding: China iron-ore imports +3.1% Jan–Oct 2026; interpreted as a trade flow, not consumption.

sources_reviewed.title: SteelHome China port inventory survey
sources_reviewed.finding: 157.36 Mt monitored port inventory, +1.16 Mt w/w; trader-held inventory estimate is not an official full census.

sources_reviewed.title: World Steel Association September production
sources_reviewed.finding: Global production 0.7% lower Jan–Sep; regional dispersion; October global release due 24 November.

sources_reviewed.title: MDIC Comex Stat consolidated trade database
sources_reviewed.finding: Product-level NCM 2601 extraction shows October iron-ore volume and unit-value pressure; calculation method retained.

sources_reviewed.title: Pilbara Ports October shipping figures
sources_reviewed.finding: Port Hedland iron-ore exports 4% lower y/y in October.

sources_reviewed.title: Rio Tinto / SimFer Simandou progress
sources_reviewed.finding: 2.2 Mt shipped in H1; mine and port construction milestones are not equivalent to full capacity.

sources_reviewed.title: Government of Guinea — Simandou 2040
sources_reviewed.finding: Sovereign-fund law ratification process discussed; no claim of completed ratification or capitalization.

sources_reviewed.title: US Treasury daily par yield curve
sources_reviewed.finding: Latest complete 20 November curve: 2y 4.63%, 10y 4.92%, 30y 5.31%.

sources_reviewed.title: Federal Reserve October FOMC minutes
sources_reviewed.finding: 10–2 hold at 3.75%–4.00%; two members preferred a 25bp increase; December hike remains market expectation, not decision.

sources_reviewed.title: ECB Financial Stability Review
sources_reviewed.finding: Non-bank leverage, sovereign funding needs and liquidity mismatches remain vulnerabilities; qualitative risk assessment.

sources_reviewed.title: Central Bank of Brazil fiscal statistics
sources_reviewed.finding: September fiscal data: gross debt 82.9% GDP, nominal interest 8.99% GDP, primary deficit 0.52% GDP.

sources_reviewed.title: International Energy Agency Oil Market Report — November
sources_reviewed.finding: Crude supply recovery coexists with tight refined-product stocks, elevated diesel and freight risks.
